_source: Derived from /Users/locotoo/voight-openai/src/types.ts EventPayload interface (lines 93-108) + observed ingest behavior of @voightxyz/openai@0.1.7
_purpose: Target shape that Bitfrost VoightBackend must produce for POST /v1/events

agentId.purpose: Voight agent identifier (CUID or freeform). Optional; backend resolves from apiKey if absent.

timestamp.purpose: Event time (ms epoch or ISO 8601). Optional; backend uses receivedAt if absent.

toolExecuted.purpose: First tool name for audit-log compat

durationMs.purpose: MUST be integer (Zod strict). Bitfrost must round(end_ns - start_ns) / 1_000_000

metadata.purpose: Free-form key-value. See metadata expected fields below.

metadata_expected_fields.provider: string — base provider when source is generic (openai/anthropic/google/etc)
metadata_expected_fields.sessionId: string — UUID v4, groups events into one trace
metadata_expected_fields.spanId: string — UUID v4 per intercepted call
metadata_expected_fields.streaming: boolean? — was this a streaming call
metadata_expected_fields.tags: Record<string, unknown>? — withTrace tags (e.g., {userId, plan, org})

critical_constraints: durationMs MUST be integer (Zod validates strict, float rejected)
If voightApiKey missing, ingest must no-op silently (no throw)
Network failures must swallow silently (fire-and-forget pattern)
metadata keys with empty objects {} should collapse to undefined (not emit empty {})
If outcome='failed', errorMessage SHOULD be populated
